summary: PowerBank Corporation (formerly SolarBank) filed a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026, disclosing a fee-for-service development agreement for battery energy storage projects in Ontario. The agreement provides development services for an IESO LT2(c-2) procurement bid, a right of first refusal for EPC services, and assistance on an 18 MW BESS. It also announced debt settlement agreements totaling $1,396,717. This is an ordinary business development, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or merger activity are involved. Routine contract announcements do not qualify as special situations; the filing is a standard disclosure of business operations.
